candidates.intent_rationale: Expatriates and long-stay visitors who keep a dog or cat in Vietnam, and see locals carry animals on scooters, want to know whether a pet may ride on a motorbike, how it may be carried and what the law and the penalties say about leading an animal while riding.
candidates.content_angle: Explains what Vietnamese law says about animals on a motorbike: the ban on leading animals while riding and on carrying bulky items in Article 33(3)(đ) of Law 36/2024/QH15, the passenger ban on carrying bulky items in Article 33(4)(a), and the load limits in Article 33(5) that a pet carrier strapped to the luggage rack must respect (0.3 m beyond each side of the rack, 0.5 m behind it, 2 m high from the road); the penalties in Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for a rider who leads an animal or carries bulky items (Article 7(3)(e), VND 600,000 to 800,000) and for a passenger who does so (Article 12(5)(a), VND 400,000 to 600,000); and general advice on closed and ventilated carriers, strapping them to the rack, heat, short trips and why holding an animal in the arms or between the feet is unsafe.
candidates.working_title: Un animal sur le scooter au Vietnam : caisse de transport, laisse et ce que la loi interdit

distinct_from.reason: FR-S84 explique combien de bagages on peut charger sur un scooter et comment les arrimer. Ce sujet explique les règles et les risques propres au transport d'un animal, dont l'interdiction de le mener en roulant.
FR-S68 explique comment dépasser les buffles, les chiens et les autres animaux rencontrés sur la route. Ce sujet traite des animaux qu'on transporte sur son propre scooter.
FR-S41 traite du nombre de personnes autorisées sur un scooter. Ce sujet traite des animaux de compagnie, qui sont un chargement au sens de la loi et non des passagers.
